latestVersion.changelog:
AI Video Editor Generator Free — initial release.

- Upload and edit videos using AI-powered cloud processing with no local installation required.
- Supports common formats: MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM (max 500MB).
- Automates tasks like trimming pauses, adding transitions, and generating title cards from natural language prompts.
- Simple export to 1080p MP4, optimized for fast turnaround (1–2 min for short clips).
- Anonymous sign-in with 7-day, 100-credit tokens—no registration needed for basic use.
- Full workflow: upload, edit via prompt, preview timeline, export, and download.
